content.text: In regions where platforms like Stripe and PayPal are unavailable, digital [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-creators-ghana-get-paid-online-first-principles|How Creators]] face significant hurdles in receiving crypto [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/tron-usdt-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-methods-filipino-digital-creators-minimum-viable-stack-2|COREMERCH guide to payment]]s-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-9|payments]]. The NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers combination offers a robust solution. This guide will take you through setting up webhooks for seamless payment processing, ensuring that you can operate your digital store without the reliance on traditional platforms that may fail you.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-setting-up-nowpayments-digital-store-works-how-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment processors often impose restrictions that hinder digital creators, particularly in countries like Nigeria and Kenya. Such platforms not only delay payouts but can also deny service entirely, leaving creators without a reliable means to accept payments. By leveraging NOWPayments with Cloudflare Workers, you establish a decentralized payment system, eliminating reliance on third-party platforms. This architecture ensures that you retain control over your finances, allowing immediate access to funds without the typical delays associated with platforms like Gumroad.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To get started, ensure you have a Cloudflare account for hosting your web application and a NOWPayments account to manage your crypto transactions. Familiarize yourself with basic programming concepts, as you will be writing a few lines of JavaScript for Cloudflare Workers. Additionally, select the cryptocurrencies you wish to accept; USDT on Tron is a cost-effective choice, with transaction fees under $0.10. Setting up an integrated backend using Supabase will handle order storage efficiently, enabling you to manage product sales seamlessly.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring your NOWPayments account to generate API keys, which will be used in your Cloudflare Worker script. Next, create the Cloudflare Worker that will listen for payment events and trigger actions based on the webhook notifications from NOWPayments. This setup ensures that when a payment is confirmed, your product is automatically delivered to the customer. Store order details in your Supabase database, making it easy to manage sales and customer data. This pipeline allows for instant product delivery without manual intervention.
Empower your digital store with complete control over your payments.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, test your Cloudflare Worker to ensure it receives webhook notifications as expected. Process a test transaction using your NOWPayments account to confirm that the payment flow works flawlessly. Once you receive a successful payment notification, verify that the product delivery mechanism activates properly, sending your digital product to the customer. This step is crucial as it demonstrates that your system operates as intended, ensuring customer satisfaction from the get-go.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your payment and delivery system operational, focus on scaling. Begin by adding more products to your store, leveraging the Edge Commerce Stack, which allows you to deploy up to five products initially. As your sales increase, consider optimizing your Cloudflare Worker script for performance and ensuring that your Supabase database can handle the growing amount of data. This proactive approach will prepare your infrastructure to support an expanding customer base while maintaining efficiency and reliability.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

To receive crypto payments for your digital products, set up NOWPayments with a webhook that interacts with your Cloudflare Workers. This method allows for automated payment processing and immediate product delivery without relying on traditional payment platforms. By using USDT on Tron, you can benefit from low transaction fees and fast processing times.
No platform restrictions mean instant access to your funds.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Related searches highlight the need for a comprehensive payment solution. For those looking to implement this infrastructure, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides a complete setup that ensures reliable performance, with five products loaded and support for scaling your operations. Explore further at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Set up a self-custody wallet first — Trust Wallet or MetaMask for USDT and other coins, with the private keys stored securely and backed up. Create a NOWPayments account and configure your wallet addresses for each coin you want to accept — start with USDT on Tron and Bitcoin. Set up a P2P exchange account in your country before you need it — Binance P2P, a local exchange, or both. Deploy your stack with NOWPayments configured and the webhook endpoint set. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm USDT arrives in your wallet within the expected confirmation time. Practice a test P2P conversion with a small amount to confirm you know the process end-to-end. When your first real sale arrives, verify it in the database, confirm delivery completed, then convert to local currency through your P2P exchange.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

Set up a NOWPayments account and integrate it with Cloudflare Workers to handle payment notifications. This setup ensures that you receive payments directly in cryptocurrency, allowing for instant confirmations and product delivery.
How long does USDT payment take to arrive compared to PayPal?

USDT payments on Tron usually process within minutes, significantly faster than PayPal, which can take hours or even days due to banking delays. This speed enhances customer satisfaction by delivering products quickly.
How do creators in Nigeria convert Bitcoin to naira?

Creators can use P2P exchanges like Binance or Patricia to convert Bitcoin to naira. This method allows for quick transactions without relying on traditional banking systems, providing more control over funds.
Are there transaction fees with NOWPayments?

NOWPayments charges a low fee of 0.5% for processing transactions, making it an economical choice for digital creators. This structure enables you to keep more of your earnings compared to traditional platforms.
Can I use multiple cryptocurrencies with NOWPayments?

Yes, NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including popular options like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and USDT. This variety allows you to cater to a broader customer base and adapt to market preferences.
Scale your business effortlessly with low-cost, high-speed crypto transactions.
